messages:
Anya: quick design check  saw some user confusion where Stop clears but people wanted to tweak prompt and resume. Thinking Soft Pause flow + prompt edit inline. Figma: https://fig.ma/file/soft-pause-v1. Thoughts?
Jules: love Soft Pause. UX: show a small chip under the message: [Soft-paused  8 tokens  expires 3:00] + 'Edit prompt' and 'Resume' actions.
Kiran: runtime note: KV checkpoint survives 180s. If user edits prompt slightly we can attempt resume, but big edits should block resume. Need clear messaging for blocked resumes.
Mei: agree. Copy candidates: 'Soft-pause (preserve partial response)' / 'Discard (clear)' / 'Regenerate (start fresh)'. For edit tooling, prefill the prompt editor with the last prompt and highlight changes.
Anya: mobile consideration: long-press to open soft-pause menu (Resume / Edit / Discard). Desktop: chip + hover menu. Token peek should be dev-mode only.
Jules: accessibility: chip must be keyboard-focusable and announce state changes: aria-live = "Response soft-paused, press Resume to continue". Also confirm for Discard: explicit copy "Discard partial response? This cannot be undone."
design-bot: icon guidance: Soft-pause = dotted pause icon; Edit = pencil; Discard = filled stop (danger). Use lower visual weight for chip.
Kiran: edge case: model changed during pause -> show inline banner: "Cannot resume: model changed" with actions: 'Regenerate on current model' or 'Switch back to previous model to resume'.
Mei: Prompt Library tie-in: allow 'Save edited prompt as new' and 'Apply saved prompt' controls in the inline editor. If user applies a different saved prompt, treat as new (no resume).
aria-bot: checklist: focus order (message -> chip -> editor -> resume), aria-live announcements for pause/resume/expiry, keyboard shortcuts doc (S = soft-pause/resume, E = edit prompt, D = discard).
Anya: action items: I'll update Figma with soft-pause chip + inline editor; Kiran to prototype resume-block banner for model changes; Mei to add prompt-library save/apply flows; aria-bot to write a11y acceptance. Will tag when mocks are up. Thanks! :sparkles:
